title: TrackerDispatcherService
responsibility: Atomically plan Tracker launch intents and claims, admit runner attempts, and reconcile observed sessions and run outcomes.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.constructor.store
inputs.description: Atomic store that re-reads item, policy, session evidence and receipt state, reserves a node-local run ID and commits the plan together.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.constructor.policy
inputs.description: Executor identity, clock, placement, admission and ladder decisions. All callbacks are synchronous and side-effect free.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.request.itemId
inputs.description: Exact Tracker item ID.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.request.request
inputs.description: Manual options or due intent with a candidate token. Retries of matching manual requests keep the original token.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.claim.itemId
inputs.description: Exact Tracker item ID.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.claim.token
inputs.description: The current intent token. A receipt for the token always fences a second initial claim.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.claim.grant
inputs.description: Optional spoke authorization bound to the current token and node. Only an unreachable hub permits configured sole-owner fallback.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.prepare.itemId
inputs.description: Exact Tracker item ID.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.prepare.attempt
inputs.description: The node-local run ID and expected revision. Old observations and duplicate retry reservations are ignored.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.prepare.grant
inputs.description: Optional spoke authorization bound to the current token and node. Only an unreachable hub permits configured sole-owner fallback.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.record.itemId
inputs.description: Exact Tracker item ID.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.record.attempt
inputs.description: The node-local run ID and expected revision. Old observations and duplicate retry reservations are ignored.

inputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.record.event
inputs.description: Trusted session, monitor, verification, startup failure, confirmed startup absence, answer or rejection evidence supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: finalReportHold.run
inputs.type: { outcome?: string | null; failure_reason?: string | null; ended_at?: number | null }

inputs.name: queueRun.input
inputs.type: { item: TrackerDispatchItem; token: string; pick: TrackerLaunchPick | { error: string }; previous?: TrackerRunReceipt; }

inputs.name: failRun.failure
inputs.type: { outcome: 'failed' | 'rejected' | 'timed_out' | 'abandoned'; reason: string; exitCode?: number | null; startup?: boolean; reopen?: boolean; note?: string; usage?: TrackerReceiptUsage; }

outputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.request
outputs.description: Returns a new or existing intent, or the hold or conflict reason.

outputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.claim
outputs.description: Returns one committed runner reservation and Harness model selection, a terminal invalid-model receipt, or a hold reason.

outputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.prepare
outputs.description: Returns one committed reservation for a queued retry, a hold reason, or an ignored stale reservation.

outputs.name: TrackerDispatcherService.record
outputs.description: Returns the committed receipt and any queued retry, or the hold, conflict or stale-event reason.

errors.name: Store error
errors.description: A store read, policy callback or transaction failure rejects the operation. A reservation is released only after the store commits.
